title: chat-client: refuse ChatStreamEnable when the Session lacks chat:websocket
description: jmap-chat-wss-guide.md:108: "clients MUST NOT send ChatStreamEnable in that case (a server that does not recognize it answers with a RequestError of type notRequest)". ws.rs send_stream_enable sends without checking; the WS session does not know the Session. Size S. From audit JMAP-x3lu (docs/audits/2026-11-19-x3lu/, jmap-chat-spec 120db2c).
